message:
We all know how inconvenient it can be when our phones or other tech decide to take a break at the worst possible moment. That's why having a solid plan in place is so important. It helps us stay connected and navigate through unexpected situations without relying solely on our devices. 

We've found that making a family communication plan can be a great way to ensure everyone knows what to do, even if the tech goes silent. 📱 How do you stay prepared without your gadgets? We’d love to hear your tips!
